body.name: component-equality coordinate-alignment pattern
body.construction: Recover the unstructured label set \(\mathscr L(P_X)\) by three-view decomposition and set \(\mathcal E(P_X)=\{E_j:1\le j\le J\}\), where \(\ell\mathrel{E_j}\ell'\) if and only if the recovered conditional columns for \(X_j\) agree at labels \(\ell\) and \(\ell'\); order intersections and refinements of these equality relations by observed-child-set inclusion.
